description: List direct reference documents linked from a scene via metadata (for example, reference_ids). Returns only one-hop scene -> reference links and does not recursively traverse related references. If scene IDs are reused across projects, omitting project_id returns CONFLICT with candidate project_ids. Response shape note: returns a structured envelope (`results`, `total_count`) plus the resolved `scene_id` and `project_id` context.

project_id.description: Optional project ID to disambiguate duplicate scene IDs across projects.

name: list_scene_references
